historyPreview.lede: Spiritual and national leaders across Europe have called their peoples to unite in prayer during critical moments of challenge and decision. These initiatives strengthened social cohesion, inspired hope and faith, and in certain instances played a significant role in events that shaped the destiny of nations.

ukraine.p1: On 12 February 2025 the Parliament of Ukraine passed a resolution establishing <b>24 February as the National Day of Prayer
ukraine.p2: One year later, on 24 February 2026, that day was marked by an interfaith prayer service at St. Sophia Cathedral in Kyiv, attended by the President of Ukraine together with heads of state and government from across the continent.
